title: Just $74 Million Short: Can Skyrizi Succeed Humira as the Autoimmune Drug King?
summary: Skyrizi generated $5.505 billion in Q2 2026, only $74 million below Humira's historic quarterly peak. The real succession test spans efficacy, treatment burden, multi-indication reach and access.
